title: Pajulahti
description: pajulahti.com zoominfo.com/c/pajulahti/369113600 Pajulahti Sports Institute is one of Finland's oldest and largest sports institutes, founded in 1929 and located on 110 hectares by Lake Iso-Kukkanen in Nastola (Lahti), about an hour from Helsinki. It is Finland's only official Olympic and Paralympic Training Center, known for its focus on endurance sports and paralympic athletics. Since January 2025, Pajulahti has been merged with Kisakallio and the Helsinki-based Urhea campus into Kolmen kampuksen urheiluopisto — the largest sports institute in Finland, with 3 campuses, ~200 employees, 73,000 m² of sports facilities, 320,000 visitors per year, and ~500 students in professional sports education. The merged group generates about €26 million in annual revenue, operates on a non-profit basis (owned by foundations)
